Reviews The WAlligs Our experience with Signature Pool and Patio has been great. Bobby, the owner, has been involved since day one. He listened to our vision for our backyard AND our budget. He did not try to upsell us, like some of the other companies that came out to bid us did. We made a couple minor changes along the way, and Bobby was very accommodating. Anytime we'd reach out with questions, he'd get right back to us. He maintained communication with us throughout the project. We definitely recommend Signature Pool and Patio if you are looking for a genuine contractor, that isn't just going to tell you what you want to hear, has reasonable pricing, stays involved during the entire project, and won't disappear on you the minute you hand over that last check! Michelle M. I would highly recommend Signature Pool & Patio. From our first meeting, Bobby was prompt and professional. He followed through on every promise. The work was excellent and his team worked fast and efficient. He provided excellent customer service. My pool looks great! Thank you Bobby! ERIKA & J.C C. We were very impressed with their knowledge of leak detection ,repairs and pool resurfacing. Did a super job.Always on time,cleaned up after theirselves every day,wore masks due to the pandemic.Our leak is finally repaired and the new tile and plaster look fantastic. We would not hesitate to refer them to our family and friends.They are now our new weekly pool servicing company. KEN M Refinished my pool (plaster, decking, trim) as promised in under a week. Friendly team who did extra things to make the installation process easy and successful. Bobby was communicative and went above and beyond to find the right materials. Margaret C Bobby was great to work with. He would timely return my calls and texts. He came to check on the progress everyday.
